correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed the synchronous update. The previous-round span obstruction forces the first m source vectors to span dimension m for any (m+1)-round completion. A basis prefix yields S_r=(span of first r-1 basis vectors minus zero) union {a_r}, so every legal terminal choice is propagated anyway. Multiplying GL(m,2) by 2^(m-1)-1 proves the count for all m>=3. Exhaustive dynamic enumeration m=3,4 checks 504 and 141120 without standing in for the proof.

value.rationale: The mathematically natural next invariant after the minimum number of rounds is the entire set of optimal source strategies. The result classifies every such strategy for an infinite binary-projective family, forces a unique growth profile and redundancy of the last move, and gives an all-dimensional strategy multiplicity formula. Previously tabulated tiny cases are not promoted to the finding, and no broad conjecture is claimed.
